title: Free Energy Universality in Tensor Estimation via Generic Chaining
summary: We study high-dimensional inference problems with tensor-structured data and establish conditions under which their free energy can be approximated by that of a Gaussian comparison model. Our framework applies to models with independent observations and mismatch between the data-generating distribution and the statistical model. The results extend prior work beyond matrix settings and accommodate scaling regimes where the model parameters depend on the dimension.
